question: What was painted on British post vans during the Consignia years?
answer: Royal Mail, as before. Consignia, adopted in 2001 when the Post Office became a public limited company, was the name of the holding group; letters still went out in Royal Mail and Parcelforce vans. The ridicule fell on a word most customers never saw, and in 2002 the group became Royal Mail Group.
